ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within a grid composed of small squares with a side length of 1, points A, B, and C are located on the grid points, and point D is on the circumcircle of $ \triangle ABC$. What is the value of $\sin\angle ADC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because \overset{\frown}{AC}=\overset{\frown}{AC}$,\\
$\therefore \angle ABC=\angle ADC$,\\
$\because AB^{2}=3^{2}+1^{2}=10, AC^{2}=3^{2}+1^{2}=10, BC^{2}=2^{2}+4^{2}=20$,\\
$\therefore AB^{2}+AC^{2}=BC^{2}$, which means $\triangle ABC$ is an isosceles right triangle,\\
$\therefore \angle ABC=\angle ACB=\angle ADC=45^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \sin\angle ADC=\sin45^\circ=\boxed{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}$
